fit.basis: Chebyshev of affine(log(E)); fit natural log of positive moments
fit.selection: For each observable choose smallest degree passing BOTH training gates; otherwise choose degree minimizing LOO maximum error and retain failed gate. Selection uses training only; lock model before heldout source evaluations.

postfit_zero_diagnostics: After model lock, if fitted signed energy has an interior root, evaluate detailed physical moments at fitted root and ±1% incident energy. Diagnostics do not retune coefficients or count as preregistered heldouts.
independent_phase_anchor: At heldout7MeV integrate independent analytic-target-azimuth/transverse-shell D for BOTH targets over outgoing E and angle. Compare positive moments and signed RT-scaled difference at quadrature0.0001 gate. If incomplete preserve explicit partial status.
qualification: Pointwise measured holdouts only, no uniform error certificate; fixed-state optional moment convenience with direct physical fallback. Not a spectral kernel, matter EOS, AD-chain surrogate or production implementation.
